paragraphs.text:
When you roll a natural 6 on an
Attack die (ignore any modifiers: if
the die shows a 6, that’s a natural
6), roll another d6 and add it to the
total. If you roll another natural 6,
add another d6, and so on. You
could roll ANY number on a die if
you are lucky enough. This is called
“exploding dice roll” or simply
“explosion”.
